profile.title: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe

rows.requirement: Short-circuit ratio at the PoC
rows.source: Screening rule: an SCR of 3.0, the edge between moderate and strong grids; assumed, not a grid-code value
rows.note: No short-circuit level and inverter capacity at every point of connection, so the SCR is not known: enter the fault level and, where the network has no inverter-based generator or battery to derive it from (or has several points of connection), the IBR capacity field of each point of connection's bus

rows.requirement: Load within the energized import (after its efficiency) plus firm gensets and batteries, hour by hour (all)
rows.source: The connection's capacity and the island requirements' genset N+k and ride-through
rows.note: all: binding hour now, hourly-mean load 0 MW against the 60 MW energized import = 60 MW (checked hour by hour; the period's peak is 0 MW); no energization schedule: the connection's capacity; import efficiency from the import Link's efficiency, as entered; fixed loads only (a flexible conversion unit is a decision, not counted)

rows.requirement: Load ramp rate at the PoC within the connection ramp limit
rows.source: assumed (generic placeholder): 10% of the connection capacity per minute
rows.note: No AI-training load profile on this project, so its ramp, swing and oscillation are not known (a data-centre project created with the AI-training profile has one)

rows.requirement: Power oscillation at the PoC (0.1-2 Hz band) within the limit
rows.source: assumed (generic placeholder): 1 % of the connection
rows.note: No AI-training load profile on this project, so its ramp, swing and oscillation are not known (a data-centre project created with the AI-training profile has one)

rows.requirement: Rapid voltage change at the PoC on the AI-training load step
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning levels for infrequent rapid voltage changes at HV/EHV are about 3-5 % (not verified against the text here); 3 % used
rows.note: No AI-training load profile on this project, so its ramp, swing and oscillation are not known (a data-centre project created with the AI-training profile has one)

rows.requirement: Rapid voltage change at the PoC on an infrequent event (the whole connection switched)
rows.source: no limit set
rows.note: No limit set: the grid code sets no infrequent rapid-voltage-change tier

rows.requirement: Harmonic voltage distortion at the PoC from the site's drives and heaters
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: THD: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-6 Table 2 indicative planning level for total harmonic distortion at HV-EHV (not verified against the text here); 3 % used; Individual orders: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-6 Table 2 indicative planning levels for individual harmonic voltages at HV-EHV, % of the fundamental (not verified against the text here)
rows.note: THD 0 % (limit 3 %); no input for mill: a unit without its inputs blocks a pass; S_k 150 MVA; a screening estimate (IEC 61000-3-6 summation, U_h = I_h · h / S_k) that ignores network resonance, background distortion and the operator's allocation of the planning level; above the limit a harmonic study is needed

rows.requirement: Current distortion (TDD) at the PoC from the site's drives and heaters
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: not set by RfG/DCC; placeholder; IEEE 519-2014 Tables 2-4 current distortion limits by PCC voltage and Isc/IL (not verified against the text here)
rows.note: mill has no Harmonic source or Rated apparent power; a unit without them blocks a pass. IEEE 519-2014 Table 3: short-circuit ratio 2.5, band ≤ 20. S_sc: the fault level entered at the PoC, not IEEE 519's maximum short-circuit current, so the band can differ from the standard's. I_L: the connection's rated import at the PoC, not IEEE 519's average monthly maximum demand. Screening: above the limit, run a harmonic load-flow study.

tdd.label: screening; binding answer is a harmonic load-flow study with the grid's impedance

rows.requirement: Flicker severity at the PoC from the site's stepping loads
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: Pst: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning level for short-term flicker severity Pst at HV-EHV; a planning level, not an emission limit allocated to this installation (margin overstated); not verified against the text here; Plt: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning level for long-term flicker severity Plt at HV-EHV; a planning level, not an emission limit allocated to this installation (margin overstated); not verified against the text here
rows.note: mill: Largest power step and Changes per minute are not set; a unit without its inputs or outside the method blocks a pass; S_k 150 MVA; a screening estimate (IEC 61000-3-7 analytic method, d = step / S_k, rectangular steps, Plt = Pst for a steady pattern) that ignores the grid X/R and the operator's allocation of the planning level; units summed with alpha 3 (assumed; units stepping together are not covered); S_k is the entered S_k'' with the IEC 60909 c factor, so d may be understated by up to 1.1; above the limit a flicker-meter study is needed

rows.requirement: Voltage change at the PoC when the unit's motor starts: mill
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning levels for infrequent rapid voltage changes at HV/EHV are about 3-5 % (not verified against the text here); 3 % used; planning level, not an emission limit allocated to this installation; the project's grid code governs
rows.note: direct on line start of 2000 kW at 6 × rated, pf 0.3: S_start 14.12 MVA; dU 9.876 % (above 3 %); the PoC has no minimum short-circuit case: the entered S_k'' 150 MVA / c_max 1.1 is used; Q_gfm 0 (conservative): the grid-forming storage's reactive power at the PoC cannot be stated; a screening estimate (dU = (S_start · sin φ_start − Q_gfm) / S_sc, the grid's R ignored, one motor starting at a time); the start current multiples and starting power factors are demo values; above the limit a motor-start load-flow or RMS study is needed

rows.requirement: Voltage unbalance at the PoC from the site's single-phase load
rows.source: The grid code sets no unbalance limit
rows.note: The grid code sets no unbalance limit

rows.requirement: Voltage stability margin (P–V)
rows.source: assumed (generic placeholder): P–V margin of at least 5 % of the planned load, planning practice placeholder, not a requirement of this project's grid code
rows.note: No grid study with the voltage stability check yet: run the grid study. A screening estimate: an RMS study gives the binding answer.

rows.requirement: Voltage stability margin (Q–V)
rows.source: assumed (generic placeholder): Q–V margin of at least 0 Mvar (the Q–V curve's minimum at or below zero injection at the operating voltage), planning practice placeholder, not a requirement of this project's grid code
rows.note: No grid study with the voltage stability check yet: run the grid study. A screening estimate: an RMS study gives the binding answer.

rows.requirement: Sub-synchronous torsional interaction: unit interaction factor (TRGC 19)
rows.source: Assumed screening threshold (the grid code sets none)
rows.note: Worst UIF 0.5 · bus LV · islanded, max fault level · machine GAS. This is above the assumed screening threshold 0.1, so an EMT SSTI study is warranted for the grid-connected and islanded states. Screening; the binding answer is the EMT study.

rows.requirement: Sub-synchronous resonance: series resonance against torsional modes (TRGC 20)
rows.source: Assumed screening torsional clearance (the grid code sets none)
rows.note: The scan was not evaluated. Screening; the binding answer is the EMT study.

rows.requirement: Sub-synchronous control interaction (TRGC 20)
rows.source: the campus run
rows.note: Not evaluated: converter damping not modelled. Screening; the binding answer is the EMT study.

rows.requirement: Reactive power range at the PoC
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: DCC Art. 15(1)(a): not wider than 48 percent of the larger of the maximum import or export capacity (0,9 power factor); the relevant TSO specifies the actual range
rows.note: The project has no island requirements yet

rows.requirement: Frequency support offered by the site's converters
rows.limit: at least one of grid forming, synthetic inertia, frequency containment, fast frequency response
rows.source: Assumed: the scorecard's own expectation for a large connection; the grid code sets no limit
rows.note: The project has no island requirements yet

rows.requirement: Stay connected over the frequency ranges and times
rows.limit: 49.0-51.0 Hz unlimited; 47.5-48.5 Hz and 48.5-49.0 Hz for TSO-specified times (at least 30 min at 47.5-48.5 Hz); 51.0-51.5 Hz 30 min (Continental Europe)
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: DCC Art. 12(1) and Annex I, Table 1 (demand facilities); RfG Art. 13(1)(a) Table 2 (generating modules)
rows.note: Needs an RMS study (dynamic; EMT where the code asks for it); it applies to the site; a steady-state screening never passes it

rows.requirement: Withstand a rate of change of frequency
rows.limit: TSO-specified
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: RfG Art. 13(1)(b): the rate of change of frequency withstand capability is specified by the TSO
rows.note: Needs an RMS study (dynamic; EMT where the code asks for it); it applies to the site's inverter-based units; a steady-state screening never passes it

rows.requirement: Fault ride-through of the on-site power park modules (BESS, PV)
rows.limit: the TSO's voltage-against-time profile, within the RfG's ranges by module type
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: RfG Art. 14(3)(a) (type B) and Art. 16(3)(a) (type D): the TSO specifies the voltage-against-time profile within the RfG's bounds
rows.note: Needs an RMS study (dynamic; EMT where the code asks for it); it applies to the site's inverter-based units; a steady-state screening never passes it

rows.requirement: Limited frequency sensitive mode, over-frequency
rows.limit: droop 2-12 %, threshold 50.2-50.5 Hz (TSO-specified within these)
rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: RfG Art. 13(2)
rows.note: Needs an RMS study (dynamic; EMT where the code asks for it); it applies to the site's inverter-based units; a steady-state screening never passes it

rows.requirement: A unit that forms the island's voltage
rows.limit: a grid-forming battery or a genset
rows.source: The island study's rule: a grid-forming battery or a genset forms the voltage
rows.note: Not assessed: The project has no island requirements yet

rows.requirement: Loss of load expectation within the reliability goal
rows.source: No LOLE goal in the template's assumptions
rows.note: The project sets no LOLE goal (an ENS cap only, or none)

S1.basis: advisory screening of the saved network and its sidecars; never blocks Run. A fail is a red flag to take to the network operator; unknown means an input is missing, never a pass

rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: not set by RfG/DCC; placeholder; IEEE 519-2014 Tables 2-4 current distortion limits by PCC voltage and Isc/IL (not verified against the text here)
rows.note: mill has no Harmonic source or Rated apparent power; a unit without them blocks a pass. IEEE 519-2014 Table 3: short-circuit ratio 2.5, band ≤ 20. S_sc: the fault level entered at the PoC, not IEEE 519's maximum short-circuit current, so the band can differ from the standard's. I_L: the connection's rated import at the PoC, not IEEE 519's average monthly maximum demand. Screening: above the limit, run a harmonic load-flow study.

rows.source: EU RfG (2016/631) and DCC (2016/1388), Continental Europe: Pst: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning level for short-term flicker severity Pst at HV-EHV; a planning level, not an emission limit allocated to this installation (margin overstated); not verified against the text here; Plt: not set by RfG/DCC; IEC TR 61000-3-7 indicative planning level for long-term flicker severity Plt at HV-EHV; a planning level, not an emission limit allocated to this installation (margin overstated); not verified against the text here
rows.note: mill: Largest power step and Changes per minute are not set; a unit without its inputs or outside the method blocks a pass; S_k 150 MVA; a screening estimate (IEC 61000-3-7 analytic method, d = step / S_k, rectangular steps, Plt = Pst for a steady pattern) that ignores the grid X/R and the operator's allocation of the planning level; units summed with alpha 3 (assumed; units stepping together are not covered); S_k is the entered S_k'' with the IEC 60909 c factor, so d may be understated by up to 1.1; above the limit a flicker-meter study is needed
